notes: One coach for everything: a player profile built from your reviews, mistakes and puzzles (your old data counts straight away).
Quick setup: your chess.com ratings, a rating goal and how much time you have a day.
Today's plan on Home: a short session built around your weak spots, with a bar that leads you step by step.
New Progress page: goal, rating over time, accuracy and blunders per week, weak spots and whether your training is working, your openings.
Simpler menu: Home, Play, Review, Train, Learn.
Your saved mistakes are now sorted by theme (hanging pieces, forks, pins, checkmates…), and games reviewed in the Free Hub count too.
Boards always fit the screen, also inside chess.com and with the plan bar open.
The plan bar says when you finish a step and what's next, and lets you skip a step.
chess.com's menu shows your plan progress on the Free Hub item, and the after-game card names your mistake type with a Train this button.
